lessons.title: Fit supervised encodings and stacking within stratified folds
lessons.statement: When bank churn data mixes categorical and numerical predictors, consider this source-backed action: Proposed safe adaptation: fit encoders, imputation and selection within each fold and train the logistic stack on OOF base probabilities. Proposed check: Audit each training transform for target access and compare stack against individual bases. Limit: The source lists components but not fold-isolation implementation; this is not evidence that its code avoids leakage.
